info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Mordant Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Mordant Drill Detail Submission API allows users to submit detailed information about mordant drills for cataloging purposes. This API is essential for businesses looking to enhance their product catalogs, ensuring accuracy and completeness of drill specifications. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who need to maintain up-to-date records in their systems. By leveraging this API, organizations can efficiently manage and update their drilling equipment details, facilitating better inventory management and customer engagement.

post.summary: Create details for a mordant drill.
post.description: This operation allows you to create and store detailed information for a mordant drill, providing the necessary attributes and specifications to accurately represent it within the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to provide details for the Mordant Drill operation. It should contain all necessary parameters formatted as JSON to ensure appropriate processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogMordantDrillDetailRequest.title: Mordant Drill Request Body

mordant_drill_id.description: Unique identifier for the Mordant Drill.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of each Mordant Drill.

tags.description: Tags associated with the Mordant Drill request for categorization.

items.description: A single tag related to the request.
